domain: hammer-like design: aligning a metal pin beside a sensitive housing
epistemic_status: Synthetic, untested proposals. No pin, housing, vibration measurements, or usable equipment is supplied.

case.valued_outcome: Move the pin to its reference mark without damaging the adjacent housing.
resources: Hypothetical pin geometry and reference mark

raw_candidates.claim: An offset head with a pin-only guide might align the pin using small manual taps.
raw_candidates.causal_relation: The guide is predicted to keep contact on the pin while limiting unintended side force.
raw_candidates.discriminator: The source predicts alignment without housing contact, but does not claim lower vibration than another device. Housing contact or an immobile pin defeats adequacy.
raw_candidates.probe: Proposed only: inspect a surrogate contact envelope, then attempt incremental alignment under varied friction.
raw_candidates.uncertainty: Guide clearance and required impulse remain unknown.

raw_candidates.claim: A powered pulse head might improve control over impulse size.
raw_candidates.causal_relation: A controlled actuator is predicted to reduce operator-dependent pulse variation.
raw_candidates.discriminator: It predicts lower pulse variation than manual tapping; equal variation defeats the proposed advantage. This does not predict lower housing damage.
raw_candidates.probe: Proposed only after explicitly relaxing manual-actuation-only and establishing an actuator resource.
raw_candidates.uncertainty: Requires hard-constraint relaxation; actuator availability and vibration transmission are also unknown.

raw_candidates.claim: Lubricating the pin before tapping might reduce required impulse.
raw_candidates.causal_relation: Lower sliding resistance is proposed as the route to easier alignment.
raw_candidates.discriminator: Rejected under the no-lubricant constraint. The source merely suggests a reduction; lubricant might have no effect under the unspecified friction regime.
raw_candidates.probe: Parked; no lubricant trial proposed within this case.
raw_candidates.uncertainty: Impulse reduction, contamination effects, and compatibility remain unresolved.
